title: Response-free mathematical qualification of Bounded Entropy-Moment Reconstruction (BEMR)
scientific_question: Does the all-layer BEMR cubic entropy-dual reconstruction define one realizable, hydraulically continuous and numerically stable profile map over the unchanged C5Z synthetic B14 state/moment domain before any hydrological response is attempted?

hydraulic_relation: psi(theta) is the frozen B14 inverse retention map on the unsaturated branch
global_constraints: one storage residual and one first-moment residual for every layer
reconstruction.degree_count: 4N dual coefficients and 4N state plus hydraulic constraints for N all-moment-enriched layers
reconstruction.realizability: For every finite coefficient vector the sigmoid map keeps Se within [0.02,0.995]; no clipping or limiter is permitted.

strict_moment_domain.relationship_to_C5Z: The prescribed S,M cases remain byte-for-byte generated from the C5Z mean-Se profiles and moment patterns. C6C only checks them against the stricter [L,U] realizability bound; it does not change any target.
strict_moment_domain.failure_rule: If any unchanged C5Z target violates the stricter BEMR realizability bound, G1 fails and the route stops. The moment set may not be narrowed.

numerical_contract.solver: scipy.optimize.least_squares on the square 4N residual system using method='trf'
numerical_contract.start_definition: For each layer b0=logit((Se_bar-L)/(U-L)); b1 is the first-order affine-dual estimate 3*J/[(U-L)ybar(1-ybar)] with J=2M/(DeltaTheta*d^2); b2=b3=0 before the fixed perturbation.

invalid_trial_handling.rule: BEMR is bounded by construction. Nonfinite coefficients or residuals return one deterministic finite penalty vector. No coefficient clipping, Se clipping, constitutive continuation or regularization is allowed.

qualification_gates.G1_STRICT_STATE_MOMENT_REALIZABILITY: Every unchanged C5Z S,M target satisfies the exact [0.02,0.995] bounded-profile moment limit.
qualification_gates.G2_ALL_CASES_CONVERGE: All five fixed starts converge for every one of the 168 unchanged synthetic cases.
qualification_gates.G3_UNIQUE_NUMERICAL_BRANCH: All five starts agree on the same profile/faces within the frozen agreement tolerances.
qualification_gates.G4_BOUNDED_REALIZABILITY: Every sampled Se remains within [0.02,0.995]. This should follow structurally from BEMR and is still checked.
qualification_gates.G5_HYDRAULIC_CONTINUITY: Pressure continuity, flux continuity and the two external hydraulic residuals pass the frozen physical-unit gates.
qualification_gates.G6_STATE_RECOVERY: Independent 192-point quadrature recovers every prescribed storage and first moment within the frozen gates.
qualification_gates.G7_QUADRATURE_CONSISTENCY: 96- and 192-point state integrals agree within the frozen quadrature gates.
qualification_gates.G8_NO_RESPONSE_DATA: No C5R/C5N/C5P/C5Z hydrological trajectory is read and no free-running reduced-model response is generated.

decision_logic.C6C_BEMR_NUMERICALLY_NONUNIQUE_OR_HYDRAU: The unchanged state domain is realizable and profiles stay bounded, but convergence, branch uniqueness, hydraulic continuity, state recovery or quadrature consistency fails.
decision_logic.C6C_BEMR_STATE_DOMAIN_NOT_REALIZABLE: The unchanged C5Z state/moment targets themselves do not fit the stricter BEMR constitutive interval.
decision_logic.next_if_qualified: Authorize a separate response-free/exposed frozen-state mechanism discriminator before any free-running BEMR Layer-ROM implementation.
decision_logic.next_if_not_qualified: Stop BEMR without changing the entropy map, dual polynomial order, Se bounds, moment amplitudes, starts, quadrature or solver tolerances.

stop_rules: No hydrological response data may be read or generated in C6C.
No moment localization; every retained layer remains moment-enriched.
No change of dual polynomial order after the result.
No change of Se bounds or constitutive continuation.
No coefficient regularization, clipping or limiter.
No solver-start, quadrature, residual-scaling or tolerance retuning after the result.
No application, performance, speed or production-ROM claim.
